meta.name: python-executor
meta.description: Execute Python code in a safe sandboxed environment via [inference.sh](https://inference.sh). Pre-installed: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, requests, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright, MoviePy, Pillow, OpenCV, trimesh, and 100+ more libraries. Use for: data processing, web scraping, image manipulation, video creation, 3D model processing, PDF generation, API calls, automation scripts. Triggers: python, execute code, run script, web scraping, data analysis, image processing, video editing, 3D models, automation, pandas, matplotlib

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在沙箱中安全执行 Python 代码，处理数据、抓取网页、编辑图像视频。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要安全运行 Python 代码并调用大量预装库。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以执行你提供的 Python 代码，并返回运行结果。它支持数据处理、网页抓取、图像视频处理、3D 模型操作、PDF 生成、API 调用等任务。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 运行 Python 代码、执行脚本、进行数据分析、网页抓取、图像处理、视频编辑、3D 模型处理或自动化任务时触发。

say.text: 用 Python 抓取这个网页的标题：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会运行代码并返回标题。

say.text: 用 pandas 分析这份销售数据，并生成柱状图。
say.note: Claude 会处理数据并返回图表。

say.text: 用 MoviePy 创建一个 3 秒的蓝色视频，加上白色文字“Hello!”。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can execute Python code you provide and return the results. It supports data processing, web scraping, image/video manipulation, 3D model processing, PDF generation, API calls, and automation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to run Python code, execute a script, perform data analysis, web scraping, image processing, video editing, 3D model processing, or automation tasks.

say_en.text: Scrape the title of this webpage: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude will run the code and return the title.

say_en.text: Analyze this sales data with pandas and create a bar chart.
say_en.note: Claude will process data and return a chart.

say_en.text: Create a 3-second blue video with white text 'Hello!' using MoviePy.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a video file.
